summary: Round 1 (new module, general p, flat block construction). The three MARKS are faithful to the printed statements for every p = q + 1 and arbitrary unequal dimensions, and Prop. 2's finding is correctly filed against the PROOF's remark with the statement true (DEC-128). Déf. 1: the product cone over ∏(ℝ^{nᵢ+1} − {O}) ⊂ ℝ^{Σ(nᵢ+1)} − {O} with transitions in ∏GU ↪ GU (piBlockGU, injective, det multiplicative), and the ℝ₊*^p action is an action, jointly continuous, free, with orbits the fibres of piProj, equivariantly locally trivial at every point of ∏Bᵢ with Hausdorff factors only, globally trivial for paracompact factors; the diagonal is Déf. 3's homothety, every (λᵢ) is affine, conical iff ∏λᵢ^{dim F(Bᵢ)} = 1. Prop. 2: PiTorus q = ℝ₊*^p/diag acts at once through a hom into the projective automorphisms, freely, orbits = fibres of piBaseProj, equivariant local trivialisations with fibre ℝ₊*^{p−1}. Prop. 3: homogeneous and sweepable with Hausdorff factors only; divisible with the printed group F⁻¹(∏Fᵢ(Gᵢ)) × λ^{ℤ^{p−1}} under [∀ i, ParacompactSpace (B i)]. No blocker, no major. Two minors: (1) the divisible case's paracompactness is NOT NEEDED — a Hausdorff locally compact space with a properly discontinuous cocompact action is paracompact, so the hypothesis follows from IsDivisible itself, and the mark currently rests on an extension of DEC-128's circle-only reading; (2) `PiBase n B` (« cette variété localement projective ») is never shown Hausdorff — exactly the point DEC-122/124 made load-bearing for cone bases — though a 9-line proof from the module's own local trivialisations exists (verified in /tmp/bzaud45xy/t2.lean). Four nits. The global `(piDiag q).Normal` is safe but redundant with Mathlib's own instance; all product-type instances are scoped and verified inactive outside `Benzecri.PiCone`. `det_piCongrRight_fin` is correct and upstreamable after generalisation. Graduation: after the two minors (or, for minor 1, an author ruling).

checks.paracompact_reading: Is [ParacompactSpace Bᵢ] needed in Prop. 3's divisible case? Mathematically NO. Let B be Hausdorff and locally compact (a locally projective manifold), G ≤ Homeo(B) properly discontinuous (Mathlib's sense) with compact quotient. `exists_isCompact_forall_exists_smul_mem` (Circle) gives a compact K with G·K = B; take an open U ⊇ K with compact closure C. The family {gU} is locally finite (for a compact neighbourhood N of x, {g | gC ∩ N ≠ ∅} is finite). Given an open cover 𝒱, each gC is covered by finitely many V_{g,1..k}; the sets V_{g,j} ∩ gU form an open, locally finite refinement covering B. So IsDivisible ⇒ ParacompactSpace, and the hypothesis can be dropped (via `haveI` inside the divisible branch). Is the current form honest? Yes: paracompact is implied by the « variété » default (second countable), is disclosed as `weakened` in the REPORT and the checklist, and is asked as a question. But DEC-128 rules the paracompact reading for the circle corollary only, so as filed the MARK depends on an unruled extension
